lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，我来执行你的判决。
lines.en: Sssssss, here’s your sentence.

lines.zh: 听从我的裁决，无处可逃。
lines.en: Listen to my verdict, there’s no escape.

lines.zh: 玄武岩上，你正好做我的祭品。
lines.en: On the basalt, you make a fine offering.
Feel the blade of judgment.
Dance of the undying doom.

lines.zh: 斧刃拖过黑岩，划出一道白痕。
lines.en: My axe drags across the black rock, leaving a white scar.
Your life is over now.
Judgment day comes.
You cannot escape my judgment.
Death’s song shall play for you.

lines.zh: 斧刃拖在玄武岩上，火星四溅。
lines.en: My axe drags on basalt, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 绕过玄武岩柱，脚下无声。
lines.en: I slip around the basalt pillars in silence.
Patiently await my verdict.
Witness the judgment, you will.
Here I stand, judgment awaits.
The shadow of death falls on you.
Await the moment of judgment.
You will face my judgment.
The moment of judgment draws near.
Prepare for your end.

lines.zh: 等待我的判决，命运已定。
lines.en: Wait for my verdict, your fate is sealed.
The day of judgment will come.

lines.zh: 你的眼神逃不过我的视线。
lines.en: Your gaze escapes not mine.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱后面，藏不住脚。
lines.en: Basalt pillars hide nothing, least of all your feet.
I see your fear.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的尘，沾在我兜帽上。
lines.en: Basalt dust clings to my hood.
Your existence means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱上，我磨着斧刃。
lines.en: On the basalt pillars I hone my axe.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲里，斧子已经磨好。
lines.en: In the basalt deltas, my axe is honed.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲上，只站着我一个。
lines.en: On the basalt deltas, I stand alone.

lines.zh: 这片黑岩上，你的脚步太响。
lines.en: On this black rock, your steps are far too loud.

lines.zh: 你脖子上的脉，我看见跳了。
lines.en: I can see the pulse jump in your neck.
It hurts...

lines.zh: 斧柄在手里抖，我攥紧了...
lines.en: The axe haft trembles in my hand; I grip it tight...
What's happening?!

lines.zh: 披风下的肩膀开始发沉...
lines.en: My shoulders beneath the cloak grow heavy...
I'm almost done for...
The pain's almost driving me mad...
I can't hold on...

lines.zh: 兜帽下的视线开始发虚...
lines.en: My gaze under the hood starts to blur...

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲只我一个行刑官。
lines.en: Only one executioner on this basalt delta.
It's all over...

lines.zh: 再往前，你就踩进我的判决圈。
lines.en: One more step and you're inside my verdict circle.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱间，披风扫过灰。
lines.en: Between basalt columns, my cloak sweeps ash.
Don't tempt me!
Basalt is my home!
Don't try to deceive me!
You smell of blood!
You can't escape my grasp!

lines.zh: 玄武岩灰落在我的兜帽上。
lines.en: Basalt ash settles on my hood.
Better listen to me!

lines.zh: 别再靠近，我的斧不认人！
lines.en: Don't come closer; my axe knows no faces!
Our worlds will merge!

lines.zh: 你撞上的是玄武岩，不是我。
lines.en: You hit basalt, not me.
We meet here!
Let's collide!

lines.zh: 你轻碰了我一下，这就够了。
lines.en: One light touch from you is enough.
Collision creates power!
My shoulder plate shoves you aside.
Let's have a hard collision!

lines.zh: 我们的力量交织在一起！
lines.en: Our powers intertwine!
We will fuse!

lines.zh: 玄武岩的柱子，都是我立的。
lines.en: Every basalt pillar here is mine.

lines.zh: 玄武岩上，我扛着斧头等你。
lines.en: On the basalt, I wait with my axe.
My offspring will rule here!
We are each other's only!

lines.zh: 你是我命运中的另一半！
lines.en: You are my destined mate!

lines.zh: 玄武岩的柱间，只我们两个。
lines.en: Between the basalt columns, only us two.

lines.zh: 我的后代会继承我的力量！
lines.en: My offspring will inherit my power!
You will rule with me!
My lineage will continue!

lines.zh: 玄武岩把我们两个粘在一起。
lines.en: The basalt binds the two of us together.

lines.zh: 听到脚步声，它抬头瞥了瞥。
lines.en: It glances up at the sound of footsteps.
It stares at the ground, searching for food.

lines.zh: 啃咬着一块坚硬的玄武岩。
lines.en: It gnaws on a hard basalt rock.

lines.zh: 在石块间寻找合适的材料。
lines.en: It searches among the stones for suitable materials.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱间，我提着斧子巡。
lines.en: Among basalt pillars I patrol with my axe.
It turns quickly at the sound.

lines.zh: 我从灰里捡起一块硬东西。
lines.en: I pick a hard thing out of the ash.
It pokes its head out from the crevices.
It crunches a bone in its mouth.
It searches its surroundings.
It tracks the prey's scent.
It focuses on the target, ready to attack.
It creeps closer from the shadows.
It follows the sound's direction.

lines.zh: 警惕地跟踪着敌人的脚步。
lines.en: It cautiously tracks the enemy's footsteps.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱下，我提起了斧。
lines.en: Under the basalt pillars I raise my axe.
It searches for an opportunity to attack.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的粉末，盖住我的刀。
lines.en: Basalt dust covers my blade.
It quietly approaches the prey's trail.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱后，我的斧已经抬起。
lines.en: Behind the basalt pillar, my axe is raised.

lines.zh: 这三角洲只有我一个行刑官。
lines.en: I am the only executioner in these deltas.

lines.zh: 你的名字已经写进卷宗。
lines.en: Your name is already in the record.

lines.zh: 黑烟里的脚步声，是你的。
lines.en: Those steps in the black smoke are yours.
By custom, I sentence first, then strike.
It aims with its sharp horns.
It lets out a low growl of warning.

lines.zh: 用锋利的牙齿准备攻击。
lines.en: It readies its sharp teeth for attack.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的黑，正好藏我的斧。
lines.en: Basalt black hides my axe nicely.

lines.zh: 我踩着黑灰，一步一步逼近。
lines.en: I crunch through black ash, closing in step by step.
It warns with a tail swing.

lines.zh: 玄武岩震了一下，我吼出声。
lines.en: The basalt shudders as I roar.
It issues a warning, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 我的刃口磨了整整一夜。
lines.en: I sharpened my edge all night.
Dodge left; my axe leans left.

lines.zh: 玄武岩会记住这道血痕。
lines.en: The basalt will remember this bloodstain.
Stand still; do not drag out the sentence.
Ash settles into your collar.
This axe falls only once.
Swing the blade with might!
Strike demons on obsidian!
Cut heads with one swing!
Roar to break hearts!
Slaughter in the darkness!
Slash the life and death!
Executioner's roar shakes mountains!
Obsidian glows with blade shine!
Defend against demons!
Swing to break, no mercy!
The axe's back slams down; stone chips fly.
The blow drives you to the lava's edge.
The sentence is carried out.

lines.zh: 血溅在玄武岩上，很快干了。
lines.en: Blood on the basalt dries fast.
Born on obsidian!
Rise from lava!
Appears in deltas!
Executioner’s power!
Appears silently!
Walks from the wall!
Born from the depths!
Appears in shadows!
Appears in obsidian!
Born in smoke!

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱间，我走了出来。
lines.en: I step out between the basalt columns.
The smoke parts; I hold my axe.
The flames are burning my skin...

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱太滑，我摔了下来...
lines.en: The basalt pillar was slick; I fell...
To us piglins, water is poison.

lines.zh: 玄武岩之上升起的烟，是我的判决书。
lines.en: The smoke over the basalt is my verdict.
An arrow pierced my heart...
The magic is consuming me...
Hunger's eating me alive...

lines.zh: 电光在玄武岩上炸开，击中了我...
lines.en: Lightning burst on the basalt and struck me...

lines.zh: 虚空里连灰都没有，我的魂在散...
lines.en: Not even ash in the void; my soul is scattering...
